name: AEO Multilingual
description: Optimizes multilingual Drupal sites for SEO / Answer Engine Optimization (AEO).
project_description:
AEO Multilingual optimizes multilingual Drupal sites for Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and AI citations. Unlike traditional SEO modules that treat multilingual content as an afterthought, this module provides independent AEO scoring and recommendations for each language version of your content.

 Key Features 
 
 Per-language AEO audit: Each translation receives an independent score (0-100) based on 7 different checks 
 Hreflang validation: Automatically detect missing or incorrect hreflang tags 
 Schema markup per language: Ensure each translation has proper JSON-LD with correct inLanguage attribute 
 Visual dashboard: See AEO scores across all languages at a glance 
 Node-level checklist: Detailed recommendations for each language version with actionable suggestions 
 Translation completeness: Identify untranslated content that affects AEO performance 
 Meta description validation: Check length and presence for each language 
 Header hierarchy analysis: Ensure proper H2-H6 structure for better AI understanding 
 Image alt text verification: Confirm all images have descriptive alt text in each language 
 
 Why AEO Multilingual? 
 As AI-powered answer engines (Google SGE, Perplexity, ChatGPT, Bing Copilot) increasingly answer questions directly without requiring users to click through to websites, traditional SEO is evolving into AEO (Answer Engine Optimization). For multilingual sites, this challenge is even greater: your content must be optimized for AI citations in each language independently .

 This module fills a critical gap by providing the first comprehensive AEO auditing tool specifically designed for multilingual Drupal sites.

 Who Should Use This Module? 
 
 International organizations with multilingual websites 
 Digital agencies managing clients with multi-language content 
 E-commerce sites serving multiple markets 
 Government and educational institutions with language requirements 
 Content teams focused on visibility in AI-driven search 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 
 Drupal Core 10.2+ or Drupal 11.x 
 PHP 8.1+ 
 Required Core Modules: Language, Content Translation, Node 
 
 Recommended Modules 
 While not required, these modules enhance AEO Multilingual's functionality:

 
 Metatag: For meta description validation 
 Schema.org Metatag: For schema markup validation 
 Hreflang: For enhanced hreflang tag management 
 Pathauto: For clean URL aliases per language 
 
 Similar Projects 
 Currently, there are no other Drupal modules specifically focused on AEO for multilingual sites:

 
 AEO (Answer Engine Optimizer): Provides AEO auditing but does not handle multilingual content independently. AEO Multilingual complements and extends this by adding per-language scoring and validation. 
 Metatag / Schema.org Metatag: Essential SEO tools but do not provide AEO-specific auditing or multilingual score comparison. 
 SEO Checklist: General SEO guidance but not AEO-focused and not multilingual-aware.
